name: PSDD (PolSAR Ship Detection Dataset)
description: A PolSAR image dataset designed to evaluate CNN performance for ship detection in synthetic aperture radar imagery.
reputation: A niche, domain-specific PolSAR ship-detection dataset used in maritime/SAR research but not widely adopted outside that community.
notes: Non-LLM vision benchmark with PolSAR-specific noise (speckle) and likely class imbalance; relatively small and domain-specific, so models may not transfer to optical imagery.
